title: Useful Bane of Arthropods Rework/Buff
description: A mod that allows Bane of Arthropods to hit creepers and appear on pickaxes. Configurable
body:
Ever felt like **Bane of Arthropods** was underpowered or undesirable compared to **Sharpness** or even **Smite**?

This mod reworks Bane of Arthropods by allowing it to:
- **Affect Creepers**, in addition to arthropods  
- **Be applied to pickaxes**, in addition to regular pickaxe enchants

With this change, you can effectively deal with Creepers and spiders *without sacrificing your preferred sword enchantments*. A properly enchanted diamond pickaxe can even one-shot a Creeper.

## Configuration

The mod is fully configurable, allowing you to enable or disable specific features as needed.

If you’re unfamiliar with mod configuration on Fabric, see this guide:  
[How to configure mods (Fabric)](https://github.com/Serilum/.information/wiki/How-to-configure-mods-(Fabric)) by [Serilum](https://modrinth.com/user/Serilum)

### Available Settings

Set a value to `true` to disable the corresponding feature:

```toml
disableCreeperArthropod = false
disableAnvil = false
disableEnchantingTable = false
```
